# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Jul 30, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
The elizaOS framework saw significant progress today with the promotion of the `develop` branch to `main`, delivering critical fixes for shared-tier cloud agents and infrastructure stability. Development focused on the "Parent Suite" foundation, with major architectural components for household coordination and calendar management successfully merged.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

*   **Parent Suite & Household Coordination:** Completed the foundational architecture for the agentic parent suite, including calendar source registry, immutable scheduling drafts, household roles, and SSRF-guarded ICS ingestion. ([#17206](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17206))
*   **Production Release & Infrastructure:** Promoted `develop` to `main` to resolve critical 404 errors in Tier-0 shared agent startup probes and updated CI/CD workflows, including bumping `actions/setup-node` to v7. ([#17300](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17300), [#17275](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17275))
*   **Stability & Bug Fixes:** Addressed CI regressions, including Playwright dependency pinning, memory uniqueness in the `InMemoryDatabaseAdapter`, and cloud environment configuration splits between dev and production targets. ([#17293](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17293), [#17317](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17317), [#17312](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17312))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
*   [#17318](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17318): Update `elizaos-plugin-yieldsignal` to 0.2.2.
*   [#17309](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17309): End-to-end ownership of latency and streaming lifecycles.
*   [#17305](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17305): Bind `audit:ocr` to the resolved audit directory.
*   [#17301](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17301): Seal container env secrets into Steward vault as `vault://` refs.

## CLOSED ISSUES
*   **Dependency & CI Integrity:** Resolved workspace dependency enforcement and Feed verification issues. ([#17295](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17295))

## NEW ISSUES
*   **CI & Infrastructure Failures:** Reported failures in the zero-key scenario runner, Windows framework, and browser CI drift for transcript audio. ([#17322](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17322), [#17325](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17325))
*   **Frontend & Contribution Initiatives:** New tasks to port the `eliza-app` frontend into the monorepo and launch the `eliza.army` contribution skill/leaderboard. ([#17323](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17323), [#17326](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17326))

## ACTIVE ISSUES
*   **[#17175](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17175) [Epic] Ship the agentic parent suite:** Extensive discussion regarding the "evidence contract." While the foundation is merged, the epic remains open because the delivery ledger requires live-provider evidence (OAuth, webhooks, receipts) which is currently uncaptured.
*   **[#17176](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17176) Calendar availability:** Ongoing discussion on the distinction between "reachability" (proven) and "write path" (unproven). The issue remains open pending real provider logs.
*   **[#17178](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17178) Household roles:** Debated the implementation of grant scopes. The consensus is to keep the issue open until a decision is recorded regarding the mapping of AC2 requirements to the current three-mechanism enforcement model.
*   **[#17179](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/issues/17179) Co-parent persona:** Discussed the hardening of the grading harness. Noted that small local judges (like `gemma3`) fail to parse JSON correctly, requiring specific judge selection for valid evaluation.
